g.text: J8/J9 are 2x5 P2.00 and mate with the Motion board's J8/J9 (same Conn_02x05_Odd_Even symbol, pin N here is pin N there).

g.desc: J8/J9 are 2x5 P2.00 and mate with the Motion board's J8/J9 (same Conn_02x05_Odd_Even symbol, pin N here is pin N there).

g.text: One processor: I2C (motor drivers, IMU) + MOT_INT on J8, the odometry SPI on J9, power both sides.

g.desc: One processor: I2C (motor drivers, IMU) + MOT_INT on J8, the odometry SPI on J9, power both sides.

g.text: BOOT and RESET act on the P4 (pull-ups on sheet 02 / in the module); the P4 drives the LED. VISION_EN is gone.
